category_title: Low-achieving students who read extensively but lack interactive build-on contributions due to lack of confidence
scenario_title: Reflecting on interaction data using the Knowledge Connections Analyzer
minimal_context: The student is reviewing their personal interaction data on the Knowledge Connections Analyzer tool during an individual reflection session to evaluate community collaboration.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's look at your Knowledge Connections Analyzer data to answer our question: Are we a community that collaborates? What do your reading and build-on percentages show?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: For example, reading others' notes, I have read many notes, the percentage is 99% which is pretty high. However, when I look at built-on to others' notes, the percentage is only about 20%, which is pretty low.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: What does that data tell you about your interactions?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: The data tells me that the interaction between the other students and me is not sufficient. I need to communicate more with peers.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Why do you think your build-on percentage is at 20% right now?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I just look at the quantitative data. I even write notes at home, because I am afraid that my point or idea is not good enough...

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Let's look at your Knowledge Connections Analyzer data to answer our question: Are we a community that collaborates? What do your reading and build-on percentages show?

STUDENT: For example, reading others' notes, I have read many notes, the percentage is 99% which is pretty high. However, when I look at built-on to others' notes, the percentage is only about 20%, which is pretty low.

TUTOR: What does that data tell you about your interactions?

STUDENT: The data tells me that the interaction between the other students and me is not sufficient. I need to communicate more with peers.

TUTOR: Why do you think your build-on percentage is at 20% right now?

STUDENT: I just look at the quantitative data. I even write notes at home, because I am afraid that my point or idea is not good enough...

task.content: Analyzing personal interaction data (reading vs. building-on percentages) using the Knowledge Connections Analyzer (KCA) tool to answer the question 'Are we a community that collaborates?'
task.learning_goal: To reflect on individual performance and interactions with other students, identify strengths and weaknesses, and generate further plans to bridge communication gaps

context.environment: Interview and reflection session after a visual arts lesson on 'Design'
context.materials: Knowledge Connections Analyzer (KCA) tool, reflective journal prompts, KCA prompt sheets
context.social_setting: Individual reflection on community interaction data

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When reviewing KCA data showing a 99% reading rate but only a 20% build-on rate to others' notes
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Reported writing notes at home instead of interacting directly with peers; initially noticed only the quantitative data generated by the KCA
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Afraid that their point or idea is not good enough; feels interaction with other students is not sufficient

behavior_patterns.condition: Initial use of the Knowledge Connections Analyzer (KCA) tool
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Noticed only the quantitative data generated by the KCA; did not recognize the cognitive opportunities afforded by the qualitative information provided
